reason: A simulation-free unit test mistakenly constructed the real registered holdout design in memory before freeze. It did not execute holdout episodes or persist/print the generated conditions, but pre-generation violated the sealing rule. Invalidate that seed; use the new unused seed only after the committed freeze and durable exclusive marker.
test_rule: Holdout builder tests must use a wholly synthetic protocol and dummy seed; never instantiate either real holdout seed in tests.
effective_rule: Original protocol bytes remain immutable. Sealed execution overrides only holdout.seed with replacement_seed and binds both original protocol and this addendum hash in freeze/markers/results. No reuse of invalidated design or later promotion.
